title: ConductorDispositions
description: Per-finding outcomes recorded by the review-pipeline conductor after applying fixes or accepting risk. One file per panel (one panel per round).

round.description: 1-indexed round number within the review cycle.

findings_path.description: Absolute path to the deduper's final.md (the structured findings JSON) this disposition covers.

finding_id.description: Matches the id field in the deduper's findings.json.

outcome.description: fixed = code change applied this round. acknowledged = real finding accepted as out-of-scope risk for this PR. false_positive = conductor agreed with deduper's FP label (or, if deduper labelled valid and conductor reclassified, conductor verified the finding does not apply).

deduper_override.description: True iff the conductor disagreed with the deduper's verdict (promoted FP → valid, or rejected valid → false_positive).

reason.description: Why this outcome. For acknowledged, must justify why the finding is real but accepted (e.g., 'out-of-scope: PKCE is callback PR's work, tracked in NA-1071'). For false_positive, must cite the specific code that contradicts the finding. For fixed, a one-line summary of the change is sufficient.

fix_files.description: For outcome=fixed, the repo-relative paths touched. Optional but recommended for audit.
